title: Overview of Equity Securities
overview: Equity securities differ in voting rights, cash-flow claims, priority, and exposure to issuer and market risk.

modules.title: Types of Equity Investments
modules.explanation: Equity represents a residual claim whose voting, dividend, conversion, and priority rights vary by security. Foreign ownership adds currency, market-access, custody, governance, liquidity, and political risks.
steps: Identify cash-flow, voting, and priority rights of the security.
Map business and financial risks into the residual claim.
Add market, currency, custody, and governance effects when investing across borders.
